relation_types.name: references
relation_types.description: A source explicitly refers to another unit.

relation_types.name: defines
relation_types.description: A unit supplies a scoped definition.

relation_types.name: exception_to
relation_types.description: A source explicitly limits another statement.

relation_types.name: condition_of
relation_types.description: A condition applies to another unit.

relation_types.name: cites
relation_types.description: An explicit bibliographic citation; does not imply support.

relation_types.name: uses_method
relation_types.description: A paper reports using a method.

relation_types.name: uses_dataset
relation_types.description: A paper reports using a dataset.

relation_types.name: reports_measurement
relation_types.description: A paper reports a measurement for a stated population or experiment.
